What do you think of Vulkan? Do you think it will be a big competitor for Direct X12? DO you also think it will help to improve the Linux game library?

Since it's multi-platform I'm hoping it will become the new standard to develop games in, at least that makes sense since it would be easier to bring it to multiple platforms and being available to a bigger portion of the market at a lower price for the development team. Hopefully it would mean less shitty ports from consoles -> PC as well.

Vulkan will be the death knell of DirectX, simply because it is cross platform.

If you are a developer, creating a game for the mass market, your goal will be to sell the game to as many people as possible. Therefore, would you chose to use Vulkan, an API which will work on Windows, OSX and Linux, thereby opening up all three markets to your product, or create it using DirectX and then spend money porting it for the other platforms, as is the case now?

Companies will always go for the cheaper option, and once their developers know how to use Vulkan, I believe it will be a no brainer as to which one they will intend to use.
